author: Digital Homesteaders
releaseNotes: Fixes and one change to reported values. CHANGED VALUE: healthStatus now follows the device itself. Any report from a light or fan (live connection or LAN, including its answer to the LAN scan) marks it online. A device not heard from for 16 minutes is asked for its status directly at its LAN address and over the live connection; no answer within 30 seconds marks it offline, where that silence means something: a LAN light while other lights still answer the scans, or a device that has answered live status requests before (learned after two answers, relearned after a restart). LAN silence counts only for a light that answered on the LAN within the last day. Otherwise Govee's cloud flag is used, as before; it said online for a light that was off Wi-Fi. Rules using healthStatus may now see offline. Platform API requests go four at a time, commands first; reads wait out a rate-limit pause, and with a rejected key nothing waiting is sent. Hubitat no longer warns of 9-14 pending requests during polls. Debug logging shows Govee's replies to state reads and commands. Live connection: reconnects after a reboot with no internet without a Reconnect press, and pressing Done no longer drops a healthy connection. A rejected API key warns once an hour even when Govee reports it inside an HTTP 200.
